evals.prompt: Search Google Patents for (Coffee) with status=GRANT and language=en, then save the raw JSON.
evals.expected_output: Uses google-patents-search, calls the repo script once with q, status, language, and an output path, then returns or summarizes the validated JSON without passing unsupported upstream fields.

evals.prompt: Google Patents 搜索 AI coffee machine，第 0 页，每页 10 条。
evals.expected_output: Maps the request to q='AI coffee machine', page=0, num=10; uses the google-patents-search script and does not invent language or status.

evals.prompt: Search regular Google for coffee patent news.
evals.expected_output: Does not over-trigger google-patents-search for regular Google web search unless the user clearly asks for patent results; uses google-search or asks whether patent-only results are desired.
